title: Ruf-kun
text: “Hm? That’s about Keel-kun’s size. A wolf-ish Keel-kun with extra fluff? Wait… I feel like I’ve seen something similar somewhere before…”
“Wow, a new kid?”
“Ruf!”
It cried out proudly with its little arms crossed, but all I could see was a dog. Father’s reaction was pretty ambiguous too, I say.
“Well? What do you think?”
“Can this one talk?”
“It hasn’t been made to speak. It’s a monster.”
“Hmm.”
“Ruf!”
It came trotting briskly over to Father, eyes sparkling as it tilted its little head, then flopped over to show its belly.
“I guess that means pet me?”
Father, with practiced ease, scratched the created creature’s belly.
“Rufu rufu ru~”
“Haha, someone’s in a good mood.”
“Ruff.”
When Father let go, the licked creature popped back up, tongue lolling out with a happy pant, and started licking Father’s hand all over. I wanted to lick that hand too, I say.
“Huh. It really is just a dog at heart. Reminds me of old Wolf.”
“Well put. Bet you were feeling a bit lonely once he started talking, weren’t you?”
“Well, I’ll take the fifth on that one.”
“Say whatever you like. Feel free to think of this one as the Wolf of days gone by.”
“Will you let us pet it too?”
“Ruffuu!”
Sure thing! the creature seemed to say, allowing itself to be petted.
“So, is introducing this thing all you made it for?”
“Hah, well, think of it as entertainment. Throwing this fellow into the mix does all sorts of things.”
“Rafumi-chan. You shouldn’t drag Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan into making living things just for pranks, you know?”
“I’m not quite that far gone, am I? This is a kind of salvation, in its way. The mechanism is nearly identical to my original creation.”
“That’s somehow not reassuring at all.”
“Ahaha, it’s so cute.”
“Oh my, oh my.”
Just then, as Older Sister also reached out to pet it, the creature sprang up and put some distance between them.
“Oh? Is big sister no good, then?”
“Ruffu ruff. Ruf!”
It held up a hand, shook its head no, then took some mysterious fighting stance.
“It’s not saying no, nano. It’s saying you have to spar it first, nano.”
“Does big sister have to fight it just to pet it?”
“This one loves fighting, nano. Apparently it can’t stop getting excited around anyone strong, nano.”
“Oh my… quite the fighter, then.”
“Ruf!”
Come on, bring it! the creature seemed to say, beckoning with a raised finger like a boxer, picking a fight with Older Sister.
“Um… are you really going to fight it, Sadeena-neesan? Even though it’s this cute?”
“Well, since Raphtalia-chan says so, I suppose big sister will hold off on fighting for now.”
With a coy little laugh, Older Sister declined, all suggestively.
“Ruffu ruff!”
Come on, let’s fight! the created creature kept beckoning.
“Seems to have a lot of charm, at least.”
“Rufuu!”
“It makes a strange sound when it cries.”
“I figured a plain woof or something would do, nano, but once I actually had it cry, this is the sound that came out, nano.”
“Hmm… well, whatever. Keel-kun and the others have been leaving the village a lot too, so I guess it’s fine?”
So, what’s its name? Father asked.
“Its name is… Ruha—”
“Ruffuu!”
The created creature shushed, thumbs-up and winking.
“Is that no good, nano? Is this some kind of shared trait with its ancestor, nano? It’s got some weirdly specific personality rule going on, nano.”
Rival said, looking the creature over.
“Naofumi-sama, about the work over here… woof?”
“Ruffuuu.”
The creature bounded straight at Father, got scooped up into his arms, and while shooting pointed glances at the now-arrived Wolf, demanded to be petted, seizing the perfect opportunity.
“Yeah, yeah. You sure are charming, aren’t you.”
“Rufu… fufu.”
“W-Woof!!”
Wolf’s fur stood on end, his cheeks twitching.
“Wh-who is this? Woof.”
“Ah, apparently it’s something Motoyasu-kun and the others made.”
“That’s right. Since Azott and the others have been away from the village a lot lately, I thought you might be lonely, so I made you something similar.”
“I’m not particularly lonely, though…”
“Also, it doubles as an assassin against Azott.”
“That’s doing a lot of jobs at once.”
“Woof!”
Not to be outdone, Wolf bowed his head and pressed close, wanting to be petted too.
“Ruf! Ruf ruf!”
As Wolf approached, the creature backed away from Father, then took a stance with its tiny body, as if to say if you come any closer, it’s a fight!
“Grrr!”

Wolf, seemingly forgetting himself, snarled and tried to push past, only to take a fist straight to the face. Well, since it was just made, its level shouldn’t have been very high, but the punch still landed with a satisfying crunch.
“Yip yip! Ngh… that actually hurt.”
“Hey, hey now.”
“Rufuuun…”
It turned sparkling puppy eyes on Father, all sweetness.
“No good. Making eyes like that doesn’t make it okay.”
“Rufuu.”
Ignoring Father’s scolding entirely, it kept its eyes sparkling.
“What a shameless little thing.”
While all this was going on, Wolf sniffed at the created creature, then glared at us with the same look Big Sister had worn after the whole Raph-species incident.
“Making weird things again.”
“Well… I won’t deny that.”
“Ruf.”
“So, what’s this one’s name, anyway?”
“Rufuu.”
“Since it cries ‘Ruf,’ how about Ruf-chan?”
“Ruffuuuuu!”
No, no! it protested, waving its hands side to side.
“Doesn’t like it?”
“Ruff.”
Then it pointed at Father.
“Me? Wait, you want me to name you?”
“Rufuu.”
It kept glancing back and forth at Wolf.
“Ah, now that you mention it, I thought it looked familiar—there’s a photo of an ancestor at Wolf’s family home that looks just like this.”
“Vuuuuu…”
Wolf and the creature glared at each other—or rather, the creature looked down on him with an air of composure.
“Rufuu.”
“Hmm… does this one have a gender or anything?”
“It’s male, I say.”
Since Rafumi and Rival had told him to make it male, he’d set the gender accordingly.
“Then how about Ruf-kun?”
“Ruf.”
It shook its head, clearly displeased.
“Aw, is that no good too?”
Father looked troubled at being rejected again.
“V-Ruf, ruf ruf.”
“Ah… seems like it wants a name similar to ‘Wolf,’ nano.”
“Ruf.”
Rival said, looking at Wolf with something like pity. Since it seemed to fall under the monster category, I supposed it could understand speech.
“Then how about Woof? No wait, that just turns it into a plain wolf, doesn’t it. And it overlaps with Wolf… well, I guess ‘Ruf’ already overlaps a bit too.”
“Ruuf…”
It hummed, arms crossed in thought.
“Well, recipe-wise, Rival thinks Ruf works fine, nano.”
“Tch… Ruff.”
“Looks like it accepted it, nano.”
“Then from now on, you’re Ruf-kun.”
“Ruffuu!”
“Vuuuu.”
Wolf kept growling.
“Rufu rufuu.”
And so Ruf-kun, as he was now called, wagged his tail happily.
“Ruff! Ruf!”
He grabbed Father’s hand and pointed at something.
“Um, you want to go somewhere?”
“Ruuuu!”
“He’s saying he wants to go hunting to get stronger, nano.”
“Well, I don’t mind, but… should I be the one to take him?”
“Vau! No! Naofumi-sama, you have things to do after this!”
Wolf cut in to warn him.
“Well, I do have a bit of business, yeah.”
“Ruf.”
Fine then, Ruf-kun let go of Father’s hand and turned to cry toward Rafumi instead.
“Very well. I shall be the one to take you, then.”
“Don’t go teaching him anything weird, okay?”
“And what exactly counts as ‘weird’? Hm? Go on, say it. What exactly do you think I’d teach this one?”
“I don’t know exactly, but you do tend to do plenty of questionable things normally, Rafumi-chan.”
“Ha! No trust at all, I see. Should I take that as permission to play with him however I like, without restraint?”
“If you think that’s the takeaway, maybe reconsider your usual conduct…”
Father sighed and shot back at Rafumi.
“Couldn’t say. Well, I’ll have him do all sorts of things, but teach him poorly and he won’t learn a thing anyway. He’s the type who does what he wants.”
“That’s basically the same as you. Though the direction might differ.”
“Rufuu! Ruffu!”
Let’s go, then! Ruf-kun slapped Rafumi once on the back and dashed off somewhere.
“Well then, I’ll take him around and show him the sights. Ought to introduce him to Azott and the others too.”
“Vuuu… I sense a fight coming. Also… he reminds me of someone somehow. Woof…”
“Well, sounds like they heard something and modeled him after somebody.”
“The other day, Rafumi and Gaelion came asking me all sorts of questions, then were hanging around nearby. I had a bad feeling about that at the time.”
I still had no real idea what the ingredients for this one had been, but it seemed that, on top of everything else, he’d also been made to torment Wolf a little.
